title: Smallest Rotation with Highest Score
description: Find the rotation index k that maximizes the score (number of elements where nums[i] <= i).
pseudocode:
1. Initialize changes array of size n with 0s
2. For each element x at index i: calculate k range [L, R] where x <= (i - k + n) % n
3. Mark range boundaries in changes array
4. Perform prefix sum on changes to find max score index

steps.note: Initialize changes array for input [2,3,1,4,0]. Size 5.
Calculate rotation impact for element 2 at index 0. Score condition: 2 <= (0-k+5)%5. Valid for k in [3, 4].
Calculate rotation impact for element 3 at index 1. Score condition: 3 <= (1-k+5)%5. Valid for k in [3, 3].
Calculate rotation impact for element 1 at index 2. Score condition: 1 <= (2-k+5)%5. Valid for k in [0, 1].
Calculate rotation impact for element 4 at index 3. Score condition: 4 <= (3-k+5)%5. Valid for k in [4, 4].
Calculate rotation impact for element 0 at index 4. Score condition: 0 <= (4-k+5)%5. Always valid for k in [0, 4].
Compute prefix sum to find cumulative score changes for each k.
Final scores for k=[0,1,2,3,4] are [2, 3, 3, 4, 3]. Max is at k=3.
